notes.title: Golf With Your Friends 2 - First Course Reveal!
notes.content:
Golfers! It's time to grab your board and hit the halfpipe! Join us as we take a look at the first course in Golf With Your Friends 2! 🛹


Plus, you can try the course out for yourself this week at Gamescom, where Golf With Your Friends 2 will be playable at the Team17 booth! We can't wait to tee off with you all in Cologne, Germany!

notes.title: Golf With Your Friends 2 Release Plans Update 🏌️⛳
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11421109/052358d01a3deb73f06ee767b425401ffe439a1e.png"]
Golfers! Back in December, we announced Golf With Your Friends 2! Since then our development team, Radical Forge, have been hard at work building the game from the ground up in a new engine. Our goal with the sequel is to make the best possible Golf With Your Friends game we can and that means that we've had to make a few difficult decisions along the way.

That is to say that we've decided to move away from an Early Access release on Steam, and instead launch Golf With Your Friends 2 as a full release across all platforms in 2026.

This wasn't an easy decision, but it's one that gives us the freedom to make sure the sequel releases with all the polish, content and chaos that you expect from a Golf With Your Friends game!We appreciate your patience and support as we keep working on Golf With Your Friends 2! We'll have lots more to share over the coming months, including full course reveals and behind the scenes content! Keep an eye out for the Skate Park course showcase soon!


Keep up to date with Golf With Your Friends 2 by following the official X account, joining the Golf With Your Friends Discord, and wishlisting on Steam!



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3209660/Golf_With_Your_Friends_2/"][/dynamiclink]
